bms_g_4168_20001c7c.name: bms_fault_window_start
bms_g_4168_20001c7c.description: 32-bit start stamp of the fault sub-state window. bms_fault_record_service stores the value returned by FUN_0800a348 (a tick read) each time it starts a new run, then passes it to FUN_0800a528 with a 20-tick window (0x14) to decide whether the window has expired. The unit of the tick is not stated in this packet. Read and written only by bms_fault_record_service.

bms_g_4168_20001c8b.name: bms_fault_timed_out
bms_g_4168_20001c8b.description: Flag set to 1 by bms_fault_record_service when the 20-tick fault window expires while the fault sub-state handler still returns 1. The same call then commits the fault record, so the flag marks a timed-out fault run. The only write in this packet is the set to 1, so clearing it is probably done elsewhere in the firmware (not shown here).
